steps.name: Extract request information
steps.reason: Reads fields from the submitted document. Deterministic and verifiable — the extracted values can be checked against the source.

steps.name: Identify supplier
steps.reason: Matches the supplier name against the supplier register. Reversible and the match is inspectable.

steps.name: Verify price
steps.reason: Compares the quoted price with recorded supplier prices. Deterministic comparison against POL-PR-07.

steps.name: Check company policy
steps.reason: Applies written policy rules. A person wrote the rule, so applying it is not a judgment call.

steps.name: Search historical decisions
steps.reason: Similar past requests are retrieved automatically, but deciding whether a past decision still applies is a judgment call.

steps.name: Manager approval
steps.reason: Financial commitment. Only an approval record can advance this step.

steps.name: Create purchase order
steps.reason: Runs automatically, but only after an approved approval record exists for this run.
